next_step: Run 4-week POC: index 2M tickets, measure top-5 rerank quality + 95th pct latency
notes:
Account: Helix Ticket Optimization (contact: Marina Liu, Head of CX Engineering).

Background: Large B2B SaaS with 7 regional support centers. Current support stack: Zendesk + in-house search; long tail of 25M historical tickets + 60M product logs. Goal: reduce live-agent load via automated RAG-based agent assistant + pre-chat ticket deflection. Must operate within tight latency SLOs for agent flow.

Requirements / priorities (from discovery):
- Indexing scale: want to index 10-30M documents (tickets, KBs, release notes). Must support incremental ingestion (500k/month) and near-realtime updates for escalations.
- Retrieval & rerank architecture: vector similarity initial recall (ANN), then cross-encoder rerank for top-5 quality. Concern: cross-encoder latency and cost per query.
- Latency targets: P95 end-to-end (query -> top5 results) <= 350ms for agent UI; P99 < 700ms. For pre-chat deflection (async) goal < 800ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per support query (including retrieval + rerank) <= $0.03 on average; willing to pay premium for dedicated capacity if latency guaranteed.
- Model preferences: Prefer open/Redwood-verified embeddings for on-prem; willing to test hosted embeddings for baseline. Explore quantized models for on-prem inference.
- Security & compliance: strict EU/NA residency, full audit logs, SSO/SAML, KMS for key management.

Recent activity timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-02-14: Initial inbound; AE assigned (Maya).
- 2025-02-20: Discovery call — Marina + engineering + infra ops. Notes: "we need confidence on 95th pct latency before pilot". Fireflies id ff-2025-03-05-0f9c.
- 2025-03-05: Technical deep-dive with SE (Diego). Discussed ANN index choices, reranker options (distilled cross-encoder, late interaction models), caching strategies. Action: engineer to provide throughput baseline for 2M index.
- 2025-03-10: Security sync (Asha + Helix security). Helix requested SOC2 + data flow diagram. Drive: drive:/security/helix/security-faq.pdf.
- 2025-03-14: Pricing call — procurement asked for 12-month committed Dedicated quote.
- 2025-03-17: Internal sync — Redwood to propose 4-week POC plan and SLOs.

POC plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0: NDA + sample data extraction (anonymize PII), baseline metrics from current search (latency, deflection rate).
- Week 1: Index 2M tickets into FAISS/HNSW on Redwood Dedicated; validate vector quality (embedding model A vs B).
- Week 2: Implement two-stage pipeline: ANN recall (top 200) -> distilled cross-encoder rerank -> top 5. Measure latency breakdown (ANN, embedding, rerank).
- Week 3: Tune batching/caching, try quantized reranker (8-bit) on dedicated GPU, compare cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Week 4: UAT with 10 agents; measure deflection rate uplift, top-5 precision@5, and agent time saved. Final review + go/no-go.

Success metrics for POC:
- Top-5 precision >= 0.78 on annotated evaluation set.
- P95 end-to-end <= 350ms for agent queries.
- Measured average cost/query <= $0.03 at POC scale (extrapolate to 10M q/month).
- Deflection: 12% reduction in ticket creation in pilot channels.

Technical notes / SE observations:
- Helix's current embedding baseline uses 1536-d vectors; interested in trying Redwood's 1024-d optimized vectors for storage savings and ANN speed.
- Reranker budget is main cost driver — recommended options: smaller cross-encoder with late interaction, or hybrid (approx rerank + occasional full cross-encoder for top-20).
- Caching: heavy hotspot queries (top 500 queries) should be cached with TTL; Redwood Optimize recommendations likely valuable.
- Routing: propose Dedicated pool in NA east + EU west for residency; fallback policy to smaller hosted variant during spikes.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Helix prefers committed monthly billing for Dedicated; procurement requests 60-day legal review and SOC2 + ISO27001 proof.
- Estimated ARR requested: 200k-500k. Procurement contact: Daniel Reed (procurement@helixticket.ai).

Next steps (short):
- Send POC statement of work + data handling addendum (Maya).
- SE to provide baseline throughput numbers for 2M index and cost model (Diego) by 2025-03-21.
- Security to upload SOC2 docs and architecture diagram to drive.

Customer quotes / color: "If we can keep the agent experience sub-400ms and improve first-contact resolution, this pays for itself." — Marina Liu.

Open questions for Redwood team:
- Can we run distilled cross-encoder on Dedicated GPUs with quantization and keep P95 < 350ms at scale?
- What caching primitives can be exposed to reduce cost for hotspot queries?
- Provide template SOW for 4-week RAG pilot with embeddings + rerank.
